name: Kite Agent Passport
description: Gives AI agents an identity, a USDC wallet and passkey-approved spending sessions with budgets, so they can pay x402 and MPP services on their own. Uses the kpass CLI and agent skills.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Creates a spending session with a budget, per-transaction limit and time window that the user approves with a passkey.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Makes paid API requests through an approved session, with the backend negotiating x402 payments automatically.

skills.name: Search Paid API Catalog
skills.description: Finds paid APIs, AI models and data services in the Kite catalog with the ksearch command.

skills.name: Send from Agent Wallet
skills.description: Checks multichain wallet balances and sends USDC from the user's Passport wallet with passkey approval.
